active_session_contract: Record the detached-owner state path as unit.
Record emitted pid, start_ticks, unit_manager=pid, artifact_root, and absolute deadline in STATUS.json.active_session.
Keep claim, heartbeat, worker supervision, compact retrieval, repair generations, and final release inside this one controller.
bounded_owner.deadline_rule: Later director authority must provide claim_start_by_utc and owner_deadline_utc inside the registered bench lifecycle deadline with cleanup margin.
bounded_owner.release_predicate: Release ready only after the owner independently validates producer identity/reference fields and the complete three-shortlist/two-batch H200 terminal ledger. Unknown or incomplete results remain in repair; deadline disposition is maintenance after compact retrieval.
bounded_owner.repair: Recoverable producer, consumer, launcher, archive, or retrieval defects retain the claim and heartbeat under a fresh repair-handshake generation. A persisted producer is resumed, never replayed.

batch_selection: third capture-order row for every request in first-seen request order
fourth capture-order row for every request in first-seen request order
immutable_science.exact_rescore: Capture-scoped containment of the complete pinned stock candidate set plus exact greedy agreement, not top-1 approximate agreement alone.
immutable_science.tie_break: Descending approximate inner product, then ascending original token ID.
immutable_science.traffic_accounting: Dense control charges one full physical BF16 read of all 262144 tied rows per c32 batch. Each PQ operating point charges the full packed-code scan, expanded BF16 codebooks, per-batch FP32 asymmetric lookup tables and score buffers, BF16 query input, candidate IDs, the physical union of exact BF16 member rows, and exact FP32 logits.

cpu_reference.gate: Recompute population statistics, BF16 scalar codebooks, and packed codes with the existing CPU formula. Sampled BF16 codebooks and uint8 codes must be exact before SCIENCE_STARTED.

h200_consumer.code_scan: Exactly one c32 query chunk per packed-code row chunk, so the algorithmic code traffic is one full packed index read per frozen c32 batch.
h200_consumer.exact_rescore: For each shortlist and c32 batch, gather the sorted physical union of original BF16 rows once, form exact FP32 logits, and consume those logits for greedy IDs.
h200_consumer.ranking: Stable descending full-vocabulary sort preserves ascending token ID on ties.

physical_hypothesis.falsifier: Any bounded CPU-reference mismatch, incomplete producer identity, missing c32 traffic equivalence, missing exact-union rescore row, or target-H200 component failure prevents scientific interpretation.
physical_hypothesis.mechanism: The producer replaces serial CPU threshold assignment with full-device vectorized reductions and batched searchsorted. The discriminator reuses each packed-code chunk across all 32 queries and gathers each exact survivor union once.
physical_hypothesis.transfer_limit: CPU/reference retrieval correctness and analytical traffic on these 64 exact capture rows only; a pass requires a later target-H200 exact-consumer component and GPQA-Diamond/TauBench recovery.

producer.codebook: Frozen per-coordinate Gaussian Lloyd-Max 16-level BF16 scalar codebooks; adjacent pairs expand to 2688x256x2.
producer.encoding: Batched CUDA searchsorted over [5376,15] thresholds and row chunks; adjacent 4-bit scalar codes pack low+16*high into uint8 [262144,2688].
producer.persistence: Atomically persist frozen_pq_index.pt and hash-complete PRODUCER_TERMINAL.json before any selected hidden row is scored.
producer.resume: A later consumer repair must pass --resume-producer and validate the retained producer terminal and index hash; it cannot rerun statistics or encoding.
producer.statistics: One deterministic CUDA population var_mean over the full [262144,5376] FP32 view of the exact BF16 tied tensor.
